summary: John's 9th-great-grandfather; of Fordham Manor and West Farms, Westchester, on record 1680-1718.
bio: William Davenport of Fordham Manor and West Farms, Westchester, is on record 1680-1718 with wife Mary (Westchester deeds, NYGBR 51:40, 52:71, 77). Bolton says 'William Davenport and his wife Mary came from England in 1670' (speculative); Giles & Franklin think he came as a boy. A John Davenport 'of Long Neck', Westchester (deed 1682/3) is a possible father (speculative). English origin unknown; Bramhall/Bromhall Cheshire and Rev. John Davenport connections unsupported or disproven.
